scores.evidence: The three can-do objectives each have 2 or more questions with objectiveId. o1 has q1, q2, ps1, ps2 and e1, all apply. o2 has q5, e3 and e4, all analyze. o3 has q3, q4, e5 and e6, apply and analyze, and e6 (`gh pr create`) is a transfer item for 「書ける」. e1 now sets 「長い修正作業を任せます」, so it no longer contradicts q1's plan-mode advice.

hook-lead recalls lesson 1 and poses the problem in three short sentences: 「便利ですが、pushまで知らないうちに進んだら困ります」. The ungraded predict q0 asks what happens to `git push` by default. Its options are now parallel, with no hedging cue (「確認なしで、そのまま実行される」 vs 「確認の画面が出て、あなたの許可を待つ」). It leads straight to o3.

Prerequisites are listed, and hook-lead and rules-task recall lesson 1 and `cc-practice`. Terms are defined before use and match the glossary. auto-lead now ties 「2-1の表で「安全チェック」と呼んだものです」 to 分類器, and e6 glosses `gh`. In auto-defaults, 「force pushや `git reset --hard`」 is still unexplained for a learner who only knows commit and push.

measure.mjs: 「prose 1827 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2481 · practice reading 796 · questions 13 · practice sections 2 · est 19.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」. estMinutes matches, and lint reports 0 sentence or paragraph warnings. Every segment has a table, diagram or quiz. The heaviest segments are modes (権限モード plus six mode names in a table) and rules, which names four rule terms (権限ルール and 許可・確認・拒否ルール).

rules-example comes before practice-rules. Each example-steps step has a subgoal label (確認か拒否かを決める / ルールの形に書く / 読み込まれたか確かめる), a reason (「pushは中身を見たいので[[確認ルール]]」, 「書いただけでは効いたかわかりません」) and an expect, followed by example-code. p-rule then jumps straight to 「2-4を見ずに」 with no faded step in between.

All five content segments end in an inline apply or analyze quiz with feedback on every wrong option, and answer positions are now balanced. Some items are still cued. In q5 the key is the only option with 「編集ツール」, the word in the table caption. ps2's 「差分を見ながら」 repeats the modes-table cell. e5's key `git -C . push` is the exact string from example-pitfall.

Every misconception in the brief is a distractor, and each feedback corrects it with a reason in 2 sentences or fewer. Examples: q2 a (「分類器も…見逃します（…17%）」), q3 a (「確認ルールが先に調べられます。ルールの広さや書いた順では決まりません」), q4 c and d (deny vs ask, missing `*`), e4 a and b (rewind vs git), e6 d (CLAUDE.md is not enforcement) and e1 b, c, d (short bypass, prompt instructions, approval fatigue). Nothing contradicts anything else any more.

rules-diagram is a process flow with 8 nodes. Its Japanese labels match the text (拒否ルール/確認ルール/許可ルール/権限モード), the caption states the takeaway (「拒否 → 確認 → 許可の順に調べられ、最初に一致したもので決まる」) and the alt is complete. rules-order now defers to the diagram instead of repeating it. Both tables are comparisons whose captions state the point, and there are no images.

practice-rules is authentic and safe: a dummy `.env` added to `.gitignore`, no remote, and predict-first steps. Every step has an expect, the ladder is hint → troubleshoot → 2-4 code, and rules-prompt now gives a success criterion (「`Read(./.env)` と `Bash(git push *)` が理由に挙がれば成功です」) without over-claiming. The transfer item pr-transfer (「自分のコマンドを1つ、確認ルールにしました」) has no example and no way to check it worked.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next names the next lesson (第3回｜探索→計画→実装→コミット, which matches the cc-03 title), and there are 7 flashcards and askTutor suggestions. The reflection line 「ほかに確認したい操作を1つ選び、ルールの形で書いてみましょう」 is an action, not a question that makes the learner reflect.

Every one of the audit's 12 confirmed fixes is applied in the current text (e5 「autoモードで作業中です」, example-pitfall 「確認ルールに一致しません。autoモードでは、確認なしで通ることがあります」, rules-defs and glossary dontAsk, q4 d, e6 c, ps1, ps2, q0, q5 c, card-ask). Versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.283, v2.1.200), and 17%, 100 checkpoints, deny→ask→allow and 「without internet access」 match the facts file. The one open doubt is modes-lead's 「作業の途中でも切り替えられます」 for all six modes (see niceToHave).

The body is consistently です・ます, warm and non-pressuring (「まず予想してみましょう」, 「大事なリポジトリでは試さないでください」), with no banned phrases. Katakana terms carry the English on first use (分類器（classifier）, チェックポイント（checkpoint）, コンテナ（container）). 安全チェック is now a glossary alias of 分類器. 「リポジトリ（repository）」 first appears inside hidden feedback (q0 b), so q1's prompt is the first visible use.

jp is the only declared locale and it is complete. rules-diagram has a Japanese caption and a full alt. The link text in hook-version is descriptive (「権限モードの公式ドキュメント（日本語）」). No plain-text field (titles, captions, step titles, checklist labels, terms, prerequisites, askTutor) contains markdown, e.g. the callout title is 「bypassPermissions は隔離した環境だけで」.

niceToHave: factual doubt (modes-lead): 「6種類あり、作業の途中でも切り替えられます」 reads as if all six modes can be switched mid-session. The facts file (docs-11) says 「`dontAsk` never appears in the cycle; set it with `--permission-mode dontAsk`」 and that `bypassPermissions` appears only if the session started with it or with `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`. Suggested text, same length: 「6種類あり、うち4つはShift + Tabで作業の途中に切り替えられます。」

auto-defaults: gloss the dangerous operations for a learner who only knows commit and push. Keep it short, because est is 19.9 of 20: 「既定で止めるのは、force push（履歴の上書き）や `git reset --hard`、本番へのデプロイ（deploy）などです。」

sort-quiz ps2: 「差分を見ながら」 repeats the modes-table cell 「差分を見ながらの編集」, so the item can be answered by matching words. Alternative: 「場面2：ボタンの文言を1か所ずつ直し、そのたびに自分で差分を確かめたい。テストの実行など、ほかのコマンドは確認したい。どのモードを選びますか？」

check-quiz e5: the key is the exact string from example-pitfall. Use the other form the audit quotes as not matching (`git -c push.default=current push origin main`) so the item tests the idea rather than the example. Change the first sentence of the explanation to 「`git -c … push` は `git push` で始まらないので、確認ルールに一致しません。」
rules-steps p-rule: add a faded step between example-code and writing from scratch, e.g. hint 「形は `{"permissions": {"ask": ["Bash(… *)"], "deny": ["Read(…)"]}}` です。」. This would move worked toward 4.
rules-checklist pr-transfer: give an example and a check: 「応用：`npm publish` など自分のコマンドを1つ確認ルールにし、`/permissions` に出ることを確かめました」.
summary-next: make the first line a reflection question: 「第1回の演習をふり返ると、確認なしで進んで困りそうな操作はありましたか。1つ選び、ルールの形で書いてみましょう。」

rules-defs: the segment names four rule terms (権限ルール plus 許可・確認・拒否ルール), one over the ≤ 3 budget if 許可ルール counts as new. It reads as one family under 権限ルール, so this is acceptable. Do not add more terms to this segment.

Previous round's must-fix items (for the record; this is a full review): estMinutes is now 20 (measure est 19.9) and e2 is gone. e1 is now an editing task. e4's key 「要る。Bashでの変更やpushは、`/rewind` では戻らないから」 is parallel in length. rules-prompt, p-run and pr-env now say 「`.env` のReadは拒否ルールで止まり」 and name script reads as the 2-4 limit.
summary: I did a full review because review-scope.mjs exited 1: objectives o2 and o3 changed, and 39 of 41 blocks changed. All four must-fix items from the previous round are gone, and every fix the fact audit confirmed is applied. The lesson's main strength is alignment: every misconception in the brief is a distractor that the lesson corrects, and the practice is safe and predict-first. The most useful next fix is the modes-lead claim that all six modes can be switched mid-session (dontAsk is not in the Shift+Tab cycle); a faded step before p-rule and a checkable transfer item would also help.
